title: Goal 3. Developer and AI SDK with structured QA and optional MCP
summary: Expose stable read, plan, apply, validation, preview and test application services without creating a second runtime.
done_when: Human and JSON commands consume one deterministic application result contract.
Discovery covers every Smart, design artifact, provider, owner, provenance and effective schema without central ID lists.
Scaffold dry-run and apply are hash-bound, fail-closed, atomic and limited to project-owned roots.
Validation, preview, test, visual QA and optional MCP delegate the accepted registries, Gateway, PreviewKernel and PageBuilder.
Public parity, full/single equality, determinism, package, consumer, security, documentation and browser evidence pass.
